author: pawandhananjay
content: <@360491619402776577> was doing some sync tests on devnet 8 and noticed that geth was really slow to sync up to head with `syncmode=full`. my codex reported 0.42 blocks/second as geth's sync speed. It synced up pretty quickly with snap sync, but just wanted to check if reexecuting during forward sync is somehow not expected to be quick enough post gloas or did i do anything wrong?
